Get ready to mingle with Desi singles at the Winter Singles Social – it's time to find your match and meet new friends and play some games!

About this Event

🪔 IGNITE: A Desi Singles Night | Ages 25–45
Festival of Lights. New Connections. ❤️📅 Saturday, November 21, 2026 | 3:00–6:00 PM
📍 Dhoom | 11776 Fair Oaks Mall, Suite M216, Fairfax, VA 22033
🎟️ Early Bird: $25 | Regular: $40
A little spark. A little chai. Maybe a whole lot of chemistry. ✨
Join DMV Experiences for IGNITE, a festive South Asian singles experience inspired by the Festival of Lights!
Designed for South Asian singles ages 25–45, IGNITE brings together culture, conversation, and curated matchmaking for an afternoon of meaningful connections.
Whether you're tired of dating apps, hoping to meet someone who shares your cultural background, or simply ready to put yourself out there, this is your chance to connect in person.
Start with group matching, enjoy complimentary tea and samosas, and discover up to 3 curated romantic matches throughout the event.
Come solo. Meet your group. Find your spark.

❤️ What's Included?💘 Up to 3 curated romantic matches powered by Matchbox🤝 Group matching to help break the ice📱 Compatibility-based matchmaking experience☕ Complimentary tea and samosas🪔 Festive South Asian atmosphere💬 Plenty of opportunities to mingle and meet other singlesNo awkward speed dating — just real conversations and thoughtful introductions!

💘 How Matching WorksNot speed dating. Smarter introductions.
IGNITE is powered by Matchbox, a compatibility-based matchmaking platform built around relationship science.
📱 Step 1 — Take the Quiz
A few days before the event, you'll receive a short matchmaking questionnaire designed to explore your personality, interests, values, and dating preferences.
🤝 Step 2 — Meet Your Match Group
Start with a curated group of fellow singles. Enjoy tea, samosas, and conversation while getting to know people in a relaxed, welcoming environment.
